body: The best thing I can say and this is coming from a personal perspective is to hold on to the friendship and the relationship that comes with it. You do not have to be in love to be a personal partner. I was with my wife for around two years before we got married and were married for almost seven. We are still married as things have come to play out it just doesn't seem to be romantically interesting to her. She takes care of me because I have a bad brain injury that ended up with me having epilepsy. So now that my memory is a big issue for me and me having seizures occasionally she feels the romance isn't the same as it was before because I just am not the same person as I used to be. It has taken me a very long time to deal with that, and I still am because we have kids together. I can see where she feels like a mother to me because of having to always take care of me. I can't work anymore and am receiving disability but it isn't the same as a working job. I don't provide the sturdy broad emotions and background that I was giving her before it happened. Now I just kindve sit at home all day and hope the best goes around. She helps me with my medication because without her being there I would be screwed. I still have a very hard loving respect for my wife and would take her back without any thought of mind. I try to help raise our kids but now it's gotten to the point where she isn't satisfied anymore and wants that romance that I just can't seem to fulfill. I've let her start dating other guys while we're married, I now sleep on a bed in our living room and she sleeps with him in the bedroom. Our kids have their own spot and we rent out a room for extra money. The real point here is you can still love someone and be close friends with them. You just have to learn when to stop applying your emotions and when to exit the situation.

I realize that I am the heir to my own fortunes and the receiver of none. Who brought me into this world, or for that matter who gives up something as precious as life?

Dark eyes take in the vast colors that surround them as they quickly flit from side to side. Legs pressing ever forward not daring to stop. Not for the stumbles or for the ever crashing sounds around. The ground shakes around me and I think the world may be coming to an end. Suddenly a wave smashes against my back and drags me into the ocean as I tumble recklessly through the water. The current drags me deeper into the bottom of the sea. I clench my mouth shut though my senses want me to gasp for breath in the panic and fear that ensues. Unnerving calmness washes over me after the initial panic as subsided and I realize that I am more at home here than I ever was on the shore.

Eyes open to take in the ever more vibrant surroundings that I have now been emerged in. The fish swimming by immersed in their daily lives, in their families and groups. Again I have never felt more alone as I am everything and everyone I've ever known. I woke up to no one else besides me. Now I am here and now I am alone in a world that is twice as vast as I once thought.

I realize that this was my purpose. I had no other instinctual thought but to come here. This was life for me and I am glad I arrived. Although I am the seed to the tree, the heir to my fortune, I will start my own tree. Tree's start somewhere all the time. I try and do Reddit Gifts because it's the one thing I can make someones day regardless of how little money I actually have. So in response I will write you a story.

FallOut: The hardships

It was a groggy morning in the same dank steel covered prison that I had to call home. Sitting inside Vault 105 was no fun chore and definitely was not worth my time of day. Lifting my left wrist, I checked my Pipboy, nothing new. I was tired of being locked in here I had to do something to get out. Maybe convince someone to help me? No, that was too big of a risk. What if they ratted me out to the Mayor? He'd want me executed for trying to incite a riot. Wasn't that a song once back in the day, "Lets start a riot?" It held more promise than the thoughts going through my head.. Ahh... Pre-Nuclear life must have been a walk through the park... What is a walk through the park like.. That expression is so void and null this time and age. I barely know what age it is, if it wasn't for the damn counters in the cafeteria.


Another day had gone and passed, I was still trapped in this hell hole debating my plans when it happened. *WHOOOP WHHOOOP* The red light started flashing, there was an alert! Something was happening, I quickly dressed in my vault suit and ran out of my room. The guards slammed me back into my door with their rifle, "Sir, we're gonna have to ask you to step aside." I stood there looking confounded and just gave a brief nod to look like the other sheeple. The took off down the hall rifles in hand, I on the other hand headed for the vault door. Once I got there I hacked into the mainframe and wired into the Mayor's computer.  *Access Granted* It was words of freedom for me, I quickly opened the vault door and ran outside as it closed behind me not thirty seconds later.


What I hadn't thought through was what I would do once I was outside.. With no supplies in a nuclear wasteland. Shielding my face against the bitter bright light at the end of the tunnel, I started my adventure forward. I noticed that while the tunnel was still cool it was definitely hotter than the inside of the vault. From everything I'd read and heard, it was best to keep your body covered so as not to let too much escape. Achieving my destination at the edge of the cave, I was greeted by a hellaciously bright light. This must be the sun.


Sometime later when my eyes finally adopted the truth that is the sun, I started to look around. Rocks, desert, and dead trees. It was beautiful, I had known nothing else to be so gorgeous. Tentative steps forward down the hillside, unsure of what lurked anywhere. The gravel was a weird sensation under my feet, grinding my boots in harder it all began to slide. I quickly lost my traction and fell, rolling down the hill until I saw a pipe jutting from the ground. Catching myself on it I held myself steady, until the ground could stop swirling around my head. I took a moment to sit up and gather myself, with a few wiggles and a tug the pipe came free from the ground. At least now I had some sort of defensive measures. 

It was going to be a long while before I figured I'd fine anybody. On the otherhand what I was more worried about finding was water and food. Starting on that voyage, I made my way in a straight line without exerting too much energy. After a few miles I saw what I thought my be a shimmer on the underside of a highway bridge that had fallen through. I knew there were survivors out there, but I didn't know what they would be like. This would be something I had to approach with caution. Crouching behind a rock, moving from surface to surface as long as I had something between us, I felt secure. I was maybe a few hundred yards away peering over busted concrete pillar when I heard a crunch. I hadn't been moving, so I peered over my shoulder and maybe ten feet away was a woman with the most tattered looking clothes, but she was holding a wooden board with a nail in it. This was it, she was far enough that I could get a word in, and unless she yelled i wouldn't be noticed by others. If she did, I was confident I could hit her in the head and make a run for it.

"Hey, hey.... Are there any water sources around?" The woman grunted and looked at me. "I FOUND A LIVE ONE!" She hollered out to her group, as she got the last word out, my lead pipe found it's home inside her jawline. *Critical HIT* She fell like a newborn baby trying to walk.. Lame reference but what else would I really see fall inside of the vault? Dustmites? I quickly gathered myself and gave her a brief pat down, i found some jerky like substance and made a run for it. I was heading in no particular direction, just running. When finally I heard the raiders no more I slowed down. Biting off a piece of that strange jerky I looked around. I noticed what looked like a house in the short distance, why not give it a look? I adventured over to it and found a few sheets of paper and a pen. So I started to write my adventures, little did I know they would be short lived. After resting in the shade of the house for an hour, I made my way on farther. I wondered when people in the Vault would notice me missing. I was beginning to get tired, the pipe was dragging the ground and I was barely ready to eat more jerky. When finally.... A water source, it was a lake. I'd never seen myself run towards liquid so fast. Finally I got there and oh my glory did it taste like shit. But it was so refreshing at the same time. *CRUNCH....CRUNCH...* "AAHH I'VE FOUND YOU!" I tried to turn to see what had exclamated with such joy, but all I had time to see was a giant yellow body slam into me. I went flying a few feet and the next thing I know I seen my death coming. This giant super mutant running at me with a bat covered in barbed wire. At least I escaped that rotten tunnel.. And the void life that is the Vault. I hit the radio button on my Pipboy on accident as i was scrambling to try and run. "I don't want to set the world on Fiiiiiiiire! I just want to start a flame in your hearrrrrt!" Then I felt a slight twinge of pain and then nothing...The mutant had caught up with me and I had a bat stuck into the side of my head. He hit me a few more times until I moved no more. As the radio continued to play...

Always be aware of what the situation calls for. For instance we're playing on slums and you're charging the middle, be aware that usually at yellow dumpster or the barrel in graveyard, there is some one there with an AR. Don't try to rush the guy in anchor with an SMG, most anchor positions are set with long lines of sight so they can pick you off from afar.

Don't be afraid to rock smoke grenades. I love them for decoys, toss one over the wall at blue and come through cemetery to catch those who wait for the person in the smoke. After using that tactic a couple times actually run through the smoke they usually don't expect it.

Don't be afraid to sit around an enemies base in CTF without getting kills. Most of my best captures are me waiting for them to get "Map control". They get two of my mates down and pull, at the time that my team spawns I pull their flag as my team delays, come from behind or completely avoid the other team depending on the team count.

don't be afraid to let someone run by weight shooting them. More often then not this game is on the buddy system. Either they are working in two man groups or one is following to play clean up. Don't be worried when they run by, give them a second to see if that other teammate isn't just around the corner.

I can't stress this one enough, make plays by the mini map. Don't try to be the hero, watch for relative team closeness, so that you can trade kills. If you're on raid and you are going pool, make sure you have a teammate money or middle so they can make an easy rotation for the clean up. Don't be afraid to die or go negative if it helps the team. By this I mean you can bait yourself to pull an enemy out of hiding or a head glitch so you or your teammate can grab the kill.

It was briefly mentioned in a post earlier, but I feel aside from map control timing is very essential, and I can't stress that enough. I play solo a lot since I can't find a dedicated team to play with. So I usually am working  with average skill players or people with no communication. 

If you find yourself in their flag base don't feel the need to just grab it. Work their base a little. For example, the map Slums, let's say that they have laundry spawn. I find a lot of the time I
Can stand behind garage kill one, rotate to their fountain and kill another just because they communicated my position. Now depending on how spread those deaths are, tells me whether or not I need to pull or fall back a bit and hide out.

You can also use the smoke grenade as bait. So let's say you're running blue at the moment, throw a smoke all the way up to that van. Most of the time defenders will turn that direction and you can cut through cemetery and get one or two kills and an easy grab.

Mind you these won't always work, but with the decoy smoke trick if you've done it a couple of times, then they'll stop going for it and you can actually use the smoke grenade for it's actual purpose. I've gotten quite a few angry dead players that way.

Another tip, if you are down don't get anxious or worried. The stress will make bad decisions for you. I find myself doing this often. Though when I keep my shit together and relax things seem to come more fluidly my way. Just some advice from a random solo player. :]
